actions.name: Anti-Magic Pulse
actions.effect: The Void Colossi emits a pulse of void antimagic. Any creatures within 8 tiles that are maintaining or sustaining a spell need to make a WIL save against 6 + WIL + d20 or lose their spell.

actions.name: Grasping Barrage
actions.effect: The Void Colossi makes up to five Vine Grasp attacks. It can only target each creature with a max of two of these attacks.

actions.name: Null Beam
actions.effect: The Void Colossi fires a beam of of unraveling energy in a 15 tile long, 3 tiles wide line. Creatures in the line need to make a Reflex save or take 10d6 force damage.

passives.name: Aura Drain
passives.effect: Whenever the Void Colossi uses Vine Grasp and hits a creatures aura it deals an additional 2d6 damage and regains  that much aura.

passives.name: Otherworldly Presence
passives.effect: Any creature that enters or starts their turn within 30 tiles of the Void Colossi and can see it needs to make a WIL save against DC 24 or be frightened 1 (2 on a critical failure). On a success they are immune to this effect for 24 hours.

passives.name: Void Form
passives.effect: The Void Colossi has advantage on saving throws with the Fear, Mind or Soul traits
